_comment: Where the catalogue importer reads and writes. Folder ids are stable; titles are here only so a human can tell which is which in Drive. Nothing in INPUT is ever moved, renamed or deleted -- the client's originals are the one thing this pipeline must not lose.

input.title: INPUT
input.role: the client's photographs, exactly as they arrived. Read only.

output.title: OUTPUT
output.role: finished transparent PNGs, named for the product.

processed.title: PROCESSED
processed.role: a record of which input files have been dealt with.

errors.title: ERRORS
errors.role: anything that could not be processed, with the reason beside it.

categories._comment: Words that suggest one of the six categories the site actually has. A suggestion only -- every match is shown for confirmation and can be changed. Nothing is invented: a word that matches nothing leaves the category empty and the product goes to review.

limits._comment: Below these, a product is held for review rather than published.

publishGate._comment: The owner's rule: a picture reaches the website only if it is a genuine cut-out AND it reads as a dimensional product photograph. Anything else is held. This is not advice the pipeline may weigh against other things -- it is the condition for publishing, and a product that fails it keeps its name, price and code and simply does not appear, which is what hold:true already does for the fourteen pieces held today.

transparent.means: a real alpha channel, with the product fully opaque and the surround fully clear. Not white, not cream, not a flattened approximation. The alpha is read back off the saved file, because a PNG can carry an alpha channel that is opaque everywhere and still look right until it sits on cream.

dimensional.checkedBy: machine rejects the obvious failures, a person confirms the rest
dimensional.means: the picture is a photograph of the object with light on it -- shading, edge, form. Not a flat scan, not a screenshot, not a photograph of a printed catalogue page, not a picture of a phone screen.
machineRejects: no alpha, or alpha opaque everywhere
interface furniture: status bars, solid colour bands, dense small text
flat field: almost no tonal range across the product, which is what a scan or a screenshot of a flat image looks like
a cut edge that failed -- a halo of the old background left round the piece
dimensional.machineCannotJudge: whether a technically clean picture actually looks premium. That is the human step, and it is why nothing publishes without the review page.

publishGate.onFailure: The product is written with hold:true and the reason recorded. The source file is copied to ERRORS/ with the reason beside it. Nothing is deleted and no product information is thrown away.
